subject: Follow-up: retention waiver & residency options for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Nimbus call recap — data retention asks / next steps

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

What we heard:
- Nimbus wants a short-term pilot with 0-retention for PII-containing conversational inputs for the patient-facing assist feature.
- For administrative logs and sync telemetry, you’re open to a 7-day KV window instead of our standard 30-day operational logs.
- Data residency: Production inference must run in EU regions for EU patients; some US workloads are fine in us-west.
- Legal will want SOC2 evidence and a written retention waiver.

Proposed next steps (owned):
- Nimbus to send the formal retention waiver and any legal template (Priya / contracts@). (Action: Nimbus)
- We’ll map a pilot design: 0-retention pathway for PII traffic + 7-day KV for admin logs, plus EU routing enforcement for EU user traffic. (Action: Redwood — I’ll draft)
- SE deep-dive to list the technical constraints and mitigation (quantization/key scrub, redaction hooks, ephemeral KV). (Action: Aditya)
- Provide SOC2 artifacts and discuss audit window with your security team. (Action: Redwood)

Attachments: I attached a short intake form to capture the waiver ask and a one-pager on EU residency for our infra. Please upload your retention waiver draft when you can.

Availability: I’m free tomorrow 11–2 PT if you want to walk the pilot plan live.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: Nimbus_Retention_Request_v1.pdf (submitted by Liam on call), Redwood_Data_Policy_EU_residency.pdf (Redwood one-pager)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbushealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@nimbushealth.com>, contracts@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2026-08-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus call recap — data retention asks / next steps

Thanks Sofia —

Confirming we uploaded the draft retention waiver (attached to this reply). A few clarifications from legal/security: 
1) 0-retention must apply to model input payloads that include any PHI/PII tokens — we’re asking Redwood to implement an opt-in scrub/redact pipeline or guarantee non-persistence for these requests.
2) For EU residency we need per-tenant routing enforcement and proof that no KV or cache snapshots are stored outside EU for EU-labeled users.
3) During the pilot, Nimbus needs a 48-hour incident window where we can request logs for debugging; after the pilot we’ll revert to 0-retention unless an incident is escalated.

We’re keen to move fast; can Redwood support the pilot in ~2 weeks?

-Liam

Attachment: Nimbus_Retention_Request_v1.pdf (legal draft)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T14:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus retention waiver draft — pilot ask (please propose options)

Aditya / Marissa — forwarding Nimbus draft. Key asks: 0-retention for PII inputs, 7-day KV for admin logs, per-tenant EU routing, and a temporary 48-hour incident debug window during pilot.

Aditya — can you outline 2 feasible pilot architectures:
A) Strict 0-retention path: path that drops inputs at the edge and uses on-the-fly redaction + ephemeral KV with no disk persistence; include limitations (which LLM features break, e.g., long-term context, embeddings).
B) Controlled short-window path: allow a secure 48-hour encrypted debug buffer that is auto-purged, with audit logs and HSM-backed keys; include how to scope access and revoke.

Marissa — commercial: what concession margin do we have on Dedicated capacity to enable EU-only routing and the pilot SLA? Also, we may need to sign an SLA exception (attached SLA-exception-form.docx).

I’ll draft the pilot SOW after we have the options. Nimbus is pushing for a ~2 week start.

Thanks,
Sofia

Quoted below:
> From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbushealth.com>
> Confirming we uploaded the draft retention waiver (attached to this reply).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Nimbus retention waiver draft — pilot ask (please propose options)

Sofia / Aditya —

Thanks for the clear summary. My take: we can approve a scoped pilot with the following commercial and compliance guardrails: 

Commercial:
- Pilot term: 30 days with an optional 30-day extension; pricing: hosted pilot at a prefixed monthly/minute rate (we’ll provide number in the SOW).
- No long-term entitlement to 0-retention across all products — this is a pilot concession tied to the SOW and technical controls.

Technical / Compliance guardrails:
- Option A (preferred for Nimbus security posture): Implement an edge-level redaction hook + ephemeral, in-memory KV; no disk snapshots. We will enable per-tenant EU cluster pinning for EU-labeled traffic.
- Option B (fallback): 48-hour encrypted debug buffer, strictly role-based access, keys rotated daily and HSM-backed. Access logs will be exported to Nimbus as a downloadable audit bundle.
- We will share SOC2 artifact excerpts and a SOC2 readiness packet within 48 business hours. Full SOC2 report requires NDA; we can route via your security mailbox.

Next actions I’m authorizing: 
- Aditya to produce a one-page technical tradeoff doc for A vs B by EOD tomorrow.
- Sofia to send the SOW + pilot acceptance checklist to Nimbus; include explicit repro/incident retrieval workflow and purge confirmation.
- Legal to coordinate on the retention waiver signature flow and DocuSign link.

I’m OK to approve the pilot provided we capture these constraints in the SOW and limit exposure — no more than one external debug retrieval per incident, with Nimbus owning the request justification.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment stubs referenced: SLA-exception-form.docx, Redwood_Data_Policy_EU_residency.pdf
